# Bang thanh vien - nguon duy nhat cho hook pre-push, CI scope-guard, CI approval-guard.
# Sua file nay = doi quyen. Chi Viet hoac Phi sua (QUY_TAC muc 9).
#
# Cot, cach nhau bang dau |:
#   ten     : ten goi, khong dau
#   nhanh   : nhanh duy nhat cua nguoi do
#   github  : tai khoan GitHub; "-" neu chua biet
#   git     : gia tri `git config user.name` tren may nguoi do; "-" neu chua biet
#   vai_tro : maintainer = duyet + merge PR cua moi nguoi, tu merge PR cua minh
#             core       = sua duoc ngoai gis/, PR can maintainer duyet
#             gis        = chi sua trong gis/, PR can maintainer duyet
#
# Tai khoan khong co trong bang (hoac github = "-") bi coi la "gis": mac dinh cam.
#
# ten   | nhanh | github               | git       | vai_tro
